    - heading "Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (MWAA)" [level=1]
    - paragraph: Simplify workflow orchestration with managed Apache Airflow securely and at scale
    - button "Get started with Amazon MWAA"
    - heading "Why Amazon MWAA?" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (MWAA) enables you to orchestrate data pipelines and workflows using the industry-standard Apache Airflow platform. Choose between serverless or provisioned deployment options to enjoy enterprise-grade scalability, availability, and security, without managing infrastructure.
    - button "Play:"
    - img "Abstract image featuring geometric shapes in pastel orange, pink, blue, green, and yellow, arranged against a light blue background."
    - heading "Amazon MWAA is accessible in the next generation of Amazon SageMaker" [level=2]
    - paragraph:
      - text: With Amazon MWAA in the next generation of
      - link "Amazon SageMaker":
        - /url: /sagemaker/
      - text: ", you can deploy and scale Apache Airflow seamlessly without operational burdens. With automated scaling and built-in fault tolerance, MWAA in Amazon SageMaker ensures your workflows execute reliably—allowing you to focus on innovation, not infrastructure."
      - link "Learn more":

    - heading "Serverless Workflows" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Amazon MWAA Serverless eliminates infrastructure management complexities by automatically executing your YAML or Python-based workflows on-demand or on schedule. Scale effortlessly to hundreds of workflows with enterprise-grade high availability—no Apache Airflow configuration required. With usage-based pricing and built-in security controls, you only pay for actual execution time.
    - heading "Traditional Managed Environment" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Amazon MWAA empowers you to maintain full control of your workflows by deploying customized environments with preferred dependencies and plugins—while we handle infrastructure provisioning, security, and scaling.
